criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, including politicians, artists, athletes, writers, and other public figures.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A cinematic work or motion picture, including feature films, documentaries, and short films.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of audio recordings issued as a single item, typically by a musician or band.

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism of the kingdom Plantae, including trees, flowers, herbs, and other flora.

categories.name: Village
categories.definition: A small community or settlement, typically located in a rural area.

categories.name: School
categories.definition: An educational institution providing instruction to students at various levels.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism of the kingdom Animalia, including mammals, birds, insects, and other fauna.

categories.name: Company
categories.definition: A business organization or commercial entity engaged in trade or services.

categories.name: Mountain
categories.definition: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding land.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages bound together, including novels and anthologies.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transportation, including cars, ships, aircraft, and spacecraft.

categories.name: University
categories.definition: An institution of higher education and research which awards academic degrees.

categories.name: Journal
categories.definition: A periodical publication containing articles on a particular subject or professional field.

categories.name: Church
categories.definition: A building used for public Christian worship.

categories.name: River
categories.definition: A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

categories.name: Lake
categories.definition: A large body of water surrounded by land.

categories.name: Novel
categories.definition: A fictitious prose narrative of book length, typically representing character and action.

categories.name: Sports Team
categories.definition: A group of individuals who play a sport together as a unit against other similar groups.

categories.name: Newspaper
categories.definition: A printed publication consisting of folded sheets and containing news, features, and advertisements.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A man-made structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, or historic site.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural or artificial feature of the Earth's surface other than mountains, rivers, or lakes.

categories.name: Play
categories.definition: A dramatic work for the stage or to be broadcast.

categories.name: Short Story
categories.definition: A piece of prose fiction, typically read in a single sitting.

categories.name: Record Label
categories.definition: A company that coordinates the production, manufacture, and distribution of music recordings.

categories.name: Town
categories.definition: An urban area with a name and defined boundaries, larger than a village but smaller than a city.

categories.name: EP
categories.definition: A musical recording containing more tracks than a single but fewer than an album.

categories.name: Compilation Album
categories.definition: An album consisting of previously released tracks or songs collected from various sources.

categories.name: Soundtrack
categories.definition: The recorded music accompanying a film, television program, or video game.

categories.name: Crater
categories.definition: A large bowl-shaped cavity in the ground, typically one caused by an explosion or impact.

categories.name: School District
categories.definition: A geographic division administering public schools within its boundaries.

categories.name: Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic category ranking above species and below family, used to classify living organisms.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic category ranking above genus and below order, used to classify living organisms.

categories.name: Magazine
categories.definition: A periodical publication containing articles and illustrations, often on a specific subject.

categories.name: Hotel
categories.definition: An establishment providing accommodation and meals for travelers and tourists.

categories.name: Club
categories.definition: An organization or association dedicated to a particular interest or activity.

categories.name: Festival
categories.definition: A day or period of celebration, typically for religious or cultural reasons.

categories.name: Manga
categories.definition: A style of Japanese comic books and graphic novels.

categories.name: Aircraft Model
categories.definition: A specific design or version of an aircraft.

categories.name: Ship Class
categories.definition: A group of ships designed to the same general specifications.

categories.name: Locomotive Class
categories.definition: A group of locomotives built to the same design.

categories.name: Locomotive
categories.definition: A powered rail transport vehicle used for pulling trains.

categories.name: Radio Station
categories.definition: A broadcasting station that transmits audio content to the public.

categories.name: Television Station
categories.definition: A broadcasting station that transmits visual content to the public.

categories.name: Television Show
categories.definition: A program broadcast on television.

categories.name: Video Game
categories.definition: An electronic game played by manipulating images on a screen.

categories.name: Website
categories.definition: A set of related web pages located under a single domain name.

categories.name: Software
categories.definition: Programs and other operating information used by a computer.

categories.name: Programming Language
categories.definition: A formal language used to produce computer programs.

categories.name: File Format
categories.definition: A standard way that information is encoded for storage in a computer file.

categories.name: Protocol
categories.definition: A system of rules that allows two or more entities to transmit information.

categories.name: Algorithm
categories.definition: A process or set of rules to be followed in calculations or problem-solving operations.

categories.name: Data Structure
categories.definition: A data organization and storage format that enables efficient access and modification.

categories.name: Library
categories.definition: A collection of pre-written code that programmers can use to optimize tasks.

categories.name: Framework
categories.definition: A software platform used for developing applications.

categories.name: API
categories.definition: A set of protocols and tools for building software applications.

categories.name: Database
categories.definition: An organized collection of structured information or data.

categories.name: Operating System
categories.definition: System software that manages computer hardware and software resources.

categories.name: Device
categories.definition: A piece of hardware or equipment designed for a specific purpose.

categories.name: Standard
categories.definition: A document that provides requirements, specifications, or characteristics for products or services.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: An organized body of people with a particular purpose, not covered by other categories.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: A planned public or social occasion.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: A prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

categories.name: Disease
categories.definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant.

categories.name: Chemical Compound
categories.definition: A substance formed when two or more chemical elements are chemically bonded together.

categories.name: Chemical Element
categories.definition: A pure substance consisting entirely of one type of atom.

categories.name: Mineral
categories.definition: A naturally occurring inorganic solid with a definite chemical composition.

categories.name: Food
categories.definition: Any substance consumed to provide nutritional support for an organism.

categories.name: Beverage
categories.definition: A drinkable liquid.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: A system of communication used by a particular country or community.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: A system of money in general use in a particular country.

categories.name: Religion
categories.definition: A particular system of faith and worship.

categories.name: Ethnic Group
categories.definition: A community or population made up of people who share a common cultural background or descent.

categories.name: Political Party
categories.definition: An organized group of people with similar political aims and opinions.

categories.name: Government Agency
categories.definition: A permanent or semi-permanent organization within a government responsible for oversight or administration.

categories.name: Military Unit
categories.definition: A subdivision of an armed force.

categories.name: War
categories.definition: A state of armed conflict between different nations or states or different groups within a nation or state.

categories.name: Battle
categories.definition: A sustained fight between large organized armed forces.

categories.name: Treaty
categories.definition: A formally concluded and ratified agreement between states.

categories.name: Law
categories.definition: The system of rules which a particular country or community recognizes as regulating the actions of its members.

categories.name: Court Case
categories.definition: A legal dispute or prosecution brought before a court.

categories.name: Election
categories.definition: A formal and organized process of electing or being elected to a position or office.

categories.name: Office
categories.definition: A position of authority or service in an organization or government.

categories.name: Monument
categories.definition: A statue, building, or other structure erected to commemorate a notable person or event.

categories.name: Museum
categories.definition: A building or place where objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are stored and exhibited.

categories.name: Library
categories.definition: A building or room containing collections of books and other materials for reading or reference.

categories.name: Hospital
categories.definition: An institution providing medical and surgical treatment and nursing care for sick or injured people.

categories.name: Prison
categories.definition: A building or place to which people are legally held as a punishment for crimes they have committed.

categories.name: Cemetery
categories.definition: A burial ground.

categories.name: Park
categories.definition: A large public green area in a town, used for recreation.

categories.name: Garden
categories.definition: A piece of ground adjoining a house, used for growing flowers, fruit, or vegetables.

categories.name: Forest
categories.definition: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

categories.name: Desert
categories.definition: A dry, barren area of land, typically covered with sand.

categories.name: Island
categories.definition: A piece of land surrounded by water.

categories.name: Continent
categories.definition: A large continuous landmass.

categories.name: Country
categories.definition: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

categories.name: State
categories.definition: A nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

categories.name: Province
categories.definition: A principal administrative division of a country or empire.

categories.name: County
categories.definition: A territorial division of some countries, forming the chief unit of local administration.

categories.name: City
categories.definition: A large town.

categories.name: Neighborhood
categories.definition: A district or community within a town or city.

categories.name: Street
categories.definition: A public road in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

categories.name: Bridge
categories.definition: A structure carrying a road, path, railway, or pipeline across a river, road, or other obstacle.

categories.name: Tunnel
categories.definition: An artificial underground passage, especially one built through a hill or under a road or river.

categories.name: Dam
categories.definition: A barrier constructed to hold back water and raise its level, forming a reservoir.

categories.name: Canal
categories.definition: An artificial waterway constructed to allow the passage of boats or ships inland.

categories.name: Port
categories.definition: A town or city with a harbor where ships load or unload.

categories.name: Airport
categories.definition: A complex of runways and buildings for the takeoff, landing, and maintenance of civil aircraft.

categories.name: Station
categories.definition: A building or place used for a specific purpose, such as a train station or police station.

categories.name: Mine
categories.definition: An excavation in the earth for extracting coal or other minerals.

categories.name: Farm
categories.definition: An area of land and its buildings used for growing crops and rearing animals.

categories.name: Factory
categories.definition: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled.

categories.name: Power Plant
categories.definition: An industrial facility for the generation of electric power.

categories.name: Store
categories.definition: A retail establishment selling items to the public.

categories.name: Restaurant
categories.definition: A place where people pay to sit and eat meals that are cooked and served on the premises.

categories.name: Bar
categories.definition: An establishment where alcoholic drinks are served.

categories.name: Theater
categories.definition: A building or outdoor area in which plays and other dramatic performances are given.

categories.name: Stadium
categories.definition: A sports arena with tiers of seats for spectators.

categories.name: Arena
categories.definition: A level area surrounded by seating, in which sports, entertainments, and other public events are held.

categories.name: Racecourse
categories.definition: A course on which horse or greyhound races are held.

categories.name: Golf Course
categories.definition: A ground on which the game of golf is played.

categories.name: Ski Resort
categories.definition: A resort developed for skiing, snowboarding, and other winter sports.

categories.name: Beach
categories.definition: A pebbly or sandy shore, especially by the ocean between high- and low-water marks.

categories.name: Waterfall
categories.definition: A cascade of water falling from a height, formed when a river or stream flows over a precipice or steep incline.

categories.name: Cave
categories.definition: A large underground chamber, typically of natural origin, in a hillside or cliff.

categories.name: Volcano
categories.definition: A mountain or hill, typically conical, having a crater or vent through which lava, rock fragments, hot vapor, and gas are being or have been erupted from the earth's crust.

categories.name: Glacier
categories.definition: A slowly moving mass or river of ice formed by the accumulation and compaction of snow on mountains or near the poles.

categories.name: Hot Spring
categories.definition: A spring of naturally hot water, typically issuing from the ground at a temperature well above that of the air.

categories.name: Geyser
categories.definition: A hot spring in which water intermittently boils, sending a tall column of water and steam into the air.

categories.name: Fjord
categories.definition: A long, narrow, deep inlet of the sea between high cliffs, as in Norway, typically formed by submergence of a glaciated valley.

categories.name: Peninsula
categories.definition: A piece of land almost surrounded by water or projecting out into a body of water.

categories.name: Cape
categories.definition: A headland of large size extending into a body of water.

categories.name: Bay
categories.definition: A broad inlet of the sea where the land curves inward.

categories.name: Gulf
categories.definition: A deep inlet of the sea almost surrounded by land, with a narrow mouth.

categories.name: Strait
categories.definition: A narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two other large areas of water.

categories.name: Channel
categories.definition: A length of water wider than a strait, joining two larger areas of water, especially two seas.

categories.name: Sea
categories.definition: The expanse of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface.

categories.name: Ocean
categories.definition: A very large expanse of sea, in particular, each of the main areas into which the sea is divided geographically.

categories.name: Atmospheric Phenomenon
categories.definition: A weather event or condition, such as a hurricane or tornado.

categories.name: Constellation
categories.definition: A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named after its apparent form or identified with a mythological figure.

categories.name: Star
categories.definition: A fixed luminous point in the night sky which is a large remote incandescent body like the sun.

categories.name: Planet
categories.definition: A celestial body moving in an elliptical orbit around a star.

categories.name: Moon
categories.definition: A natural satellite of a planet.

categories.name: Asteroid
categories.definition: A small rocky body orbiting the sun.

categories.name: Comet
categories.definition: A celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a tail of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

categories.name: Meteoroid
categories.definition: A small rocky or metallic body traveling through space.

categories.name: Galaxy
categories.definition: A system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust, held together by gravitational attraction.

categories.name: Nebula
categories.definition: A cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky either as an indistinct bright patch or as a dark silhouette against a luminous background.

categories.name: Universe
categories.definition: All existing matter, space, and time considered as a whole.

categories.name: Dimension
categories.definition: A measurable extent of some kind, such as length, breadth, depth, or height.

categories.name: Time Zone
categories.definition: A region of the globe that observes a uniform standard time for legal, commercial, and social purposes.

categories.name: Holiday
categories.definition: A day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: An activity involving physical exertion and skill in which an individual or team competes against another or others for entertainment.

categories.name: Game
categories.definition: An activity engaged in for diversion or amusement.

categories.name: Toy
categories.definition: An object for a child to play with, typically a model or miniature replica of something.

categories.name: Hobby
categories.definition: An activity done regularly in one's leisure time for pleasure.

categories.name: Fashion
categories.definition: A popular trend, especially in styles of dress and ornament or manners of behavior.

categories.name: Cosmetics
categories.definition: Products applied to the human body for beautifying, cleansing, or promoting attractiveness.

categories.name: Jewelry
categories.definition: Personal ornaments, such as necklaces, rings, or bracelets, that are typically made from or contain jewels and precious metal.

categories.name: Furniture
categories.definition: The movable articles that are used to make a room or other building suitable for living or working.

categories.name: Appliance
categories.definition: A device or piece of equipment designed to perform a specific task, typically a domestic one.

categories.name: Tool
categories.definition: A device or implement, especially one held in the hand, used to carry out a particular function.

categories.name: Instrument
categories.definition: A tool or implement, especially for delicate or scientific work.

categories.name: Weapon
categories.definition: A thing designed or used for inflicting bodily harm or physical damage.

categories.name: Ammunition
categories.definition: A supply or quantity of bullets and shells.

categories.name: Explosive
categories.definition: A reactive substance that contains a great amount of potential energy that can produce an explosion if released suddenly.

categories.name: Drug
categories.definition: A medicine or other substance which has a physiological effect when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body.

categories.name: Poison
categories.definition: A substance that is capable of causing the illness or death of a living organism when introduced or absorbed.

categories.name: Material
categories.definition: The matter from which a thing is or can be made.

categories.name: Fabric
categories.definition: Cloth, typically produced by weaving or knitting textile fibers.

categories.name: Paper
categories.definition: Material manufactured in thin sheets from the pulp of wood or other fibrous substances.

categories.name: Plastic
categories.definition: A synthetic material made from a wide range of organic polymers.

categories.name: Rubber
categories.definition: A tough elastic polymeric substance made from the latex of a tropical plant or synthetically.

categories.name: Leather
categories.definition: A material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

categories.name: Wood
categories.definition: The hard fibrous material that forms the main substance of the trunk or branches of a tree or shrub.

categories.name: Metal
categories.definition: A solid material that is typically hard, shiny, malleable, fusible, and ductile, with good electrical and thermal conductivity.

categories.name: Alloy
categories.definition: A metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

categories.name: Glass
categories.definition: A hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda and lime.

categories.name: Ceramic
categories.definition: A hard, brittle, heat-resistant, and corrosion-resistant material made by shaping and then firing a nonmetallic mineral, such as clay, at a high temperature.

categories.name: Stone
categories.definition: Hard, solid, nonmetallic mineral matter of which rock is made.

categories.name: Gemstone
categories.definition: A precious or semi-precious stone, especially when cut and polished or engraved.

categories.name: Color
categories.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.

categories.name: Shape
categories.definition: The external form or appearance characteristic of someone or something.

categories.name: Pattern
categories.definition: A repeated decorative design.

categories.name: Symbol
categories.definition: A mark, character, or object used as a conventional representation of an object, function, or process.

categories.name: Flag
categories.definition: A piece of cloth or similar material, typically oblong or square, attachable by one edge to a pole or rope and used as the symbol or emblem of a country or institution.

categories.name: Coat of Arms
categories.definition: The distinctive heraldic bearings or shield of a person, family, corporation, or country.

categories.name: Seal
categories.definition: A device or substance that is used to join two things together so as to prevent them coming apart or to prevent anything passing between them.

categories.name: Logo
categories.definition: A symbol or other design adopted by an organization to identify its products, uniform, vehicles, etc.

categories.name: Brand
categories.definition: A type of product manufactured by a particular company under a particular name.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: An article or substance that is manufactured or refined for sale.

categories.name: Service
categories.definition: The action of helping or doing work for someone.

categories.name: Industry
categories.definition: Economic activity concerned with the processing of raw materials and manufacture of goods in factories.

categories.name: Market
categories.definition: A regular gathering of people for the purchase and sale of provisions, livestock, and other commodities.

categories.name: Stock
categories.definition: The capital raised by a company through the issue and subscription of shares entitling their holders to dividends, partial ownership, etc.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: A system of money in general use in a particular country.

categories.name: Tax
categories.definition: A compulsory contribution to state revenue, levied by the government on workers' income and business profits, or added to the cost of some goods, services, and transactions.

categories.name: Tariff
categories.definition: A tax or duty to be paid on a particular class of imports or exports.

categories.name: Subsidy
categories.definition: A sum of money granted by the government or a public body to assist an industry or business so that the price of a commodity or service may remain low or competitive.

categories.name: Grant
categories.definition: A sum of money given by a government or other organization for a particular purpose.

categories.name: Loan
categories.definition: A thing that is borrowed, especially a sum of money that is expected to be paid back with interest.

categories.name: Debt
categories.definition: Something, typically money, that is owed or due.

categories.name: Asset
categories.definition: Property owned by a person or company, regarded as having value and available to meet debts, commitments, or legacies.

categories.name: Liability
categories.definition: The state of being legally responsible for something.

categories.name: Equity
categories.definition: The value of the shares issued by a company.

categories.name: Investment
categories.definition: The action or process of investing money for profit or material result.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.definition: A practice or arrangement by which a company or government agency provides a guarantee of compensation for specified loss, damage, illness, or death in return for payment of a premium.

categories.name: Contract
categories.definition: A written or spoken agreement, especially one concerning employment, sales, or tenancy, that is intended to be enforceable by law.

categories.name: License
categories.definition: A permit from an authority to own or use something, do a particular thing, or carry on a trade.

categories.name: Permit
categories.definition: An official document giving someone authorization to do something.

categories.name: Visa
categories.definition: An endorsement on a passport indicating that the holder is allowed to enter, leave, or stay for a specified period of time in a country.

categories.name: Passport
categories.definition: An official document issued by a government, certifying the holder's identity and citizenship and entitling them to travel under its protection to and from foreign countries.

categories.name: ID Card
categories.definition: A card verifying the identity of a person, often required for official purposes.

categories.name: Certificate
categories.definition: An official document attesting a certain fact, in particular.

categories.name: Diploma
categories.definition: A certificate awarded by an educational establishment to show that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

categories.name: Degree
categories.definition: An academic rank conferred by a college or university after examination or after completion of a course of study.

categories.name: Title
categories.definition: A right or claim to the ownership of property or to a rank or throne.

categories.name: Rank
categories.definition: A position in a scale of seniority or authority within an organization, especially the armed forces.

categories.name: Grade
categories.definition: A particular level of rank, quality, proficiency, or intensity.

categories.name: Score
categories.definition: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or competition.

categories.name: Record
categories.definition: A thing constituting a piece of evidence about the past, especially an account kept in writing or some other permanent form.

categories.name: Statistic
categories.definition: A fact or piece of data obtained from a study of a large quantity of numerical data.

categories.name: Measurement
categories.definition: The size, length, or amount of something, as established by measuring.

categories.name: Unit
categories.definition: An individual thing or person regarded as single and complete but which can also form an individual component of a larger or more complex whole.

categories.name: Constant
categories.definition: A situation or state of affairs that does not change.

categories.name: Variable
categories.definition: An element, feature, or factor that is liable to vary or change.

categories.name: Function
categories.definition: A relationship or expression involving one or more variables.

categories.name: Equation
categories.definition: A statement that the values of two mathematical expressions are equal.

categories.name: Theorem
categories.definition: A general proposition not self-evident but proved by a chain of reasoning.

categories.name: Proof
categories.definition: Evidence or argument establishing or helping to establish a fact or the truth of a statement.

categories.name: Theory
categories.definition: A supposition or a system of ideas intended to explain something, especially one based on general principles independent of the thing to be explained.

categories.name: Hypothesis
categories.definition: A supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.

categories.name: Experiment
categories.definition: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

categories.name: Observation
categories.definition: The action or process of observing something or someone carefully or in order to gain information.

categories.name: Discovery
categories.definition: The action or process of discovering or being discovered.

categories.name: Invention
categories.definition: The action of inventing something, typically a process or device.

categories.name: Innovation
categories.definition: The action or process of innovating.

categories.name: Method
categories.definition: A particular form of procedure for accomplishing or approaching something, especially a systematic or established one.

categories.name: Technique
categories.definition: A way of carrying out a particular task, especially the execution or performance of an artistic work or a scientific procedure.

categories.name: Process
categories.definition: A series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end.

categories.name: System
categories.definition: A set of things working together as parts of a mechanism or an interconnecting network.

categories.name: Network
categories.definition: A group or system of interconnected people or things.

categories.name: Structure
categories.definition: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

categories.name: Model
categories.definition: A three-dimensional representation of a person or thing or of a proposed structure, typically on a smaller scale than the original.

categories.name: Simulation
categories.definition: Imitation of a situation or process.

categories.name: Analysis
categories.definition: Detailed examination of the elements or structure of something.

categories.name: Evaluation
categories.definition: The making of a judgment about the amount, number, or value of something; assessment.

categories.name: Assessment
categories.definition: The evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.

categories.name: Review
categories.definition: A formal assessment or examination of something with the possibility of instituting change if necessary.

categories.name: Report
categories.definition: A spoken or written account of something that one has observed, heard, done, or investigated.

categories.name: Article
categories.definition: A piece of writing included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or other publication.

categories.name: Paper
categories.definition: An essay or dissertation, especially one read at an academic lecture or seminar or published in an academic journal.

categories.name: Thesis
categories.definition: A statement or theory that is put forward as a premise to be maintained or proved.

categories.name: Dissertation
categories.definition: A long essay on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree or diploma.

categories.name: Book Chapter
categories.definition: A main division of a book, typically with a number or title.

categories.name: Encyclopedia Entry
categories.definition: An article in an encyclopedia.

categories.name: Dictionary Entry
categories.definition: An entry in a dictionary.

categories.name: Glossary Term
categories.definition: A word in a glossary.

categories.name: Definition
categories.definition: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, especially in a dictionary.

categories.name: Translation
categories.definition: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

categories.name: Transliteration
categories.definition: The conversion of text from one script to another.

categories.name: Pronunciation
categories.definition: The way in which a word is pronounced.

categories.name: Spelling
categories.definition: The process or activity of writing or naming the letters of a word.

categories.name: Grammar
categories.definition: The whole system and structure of a language or of languages in general, usually taken as consisting of syntax and morphology.

categories.name: Syntax
categories.definition: The arrangement of words and phrases to create well-formed sentences in a language.

categories.name: Morphology
categories.definition: The study of the forms of things, in particular the forms of words.

categories.name: Etymology
categories.definition: The study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history.

categories.name: Semantics
categories.definition: The branch of linguistics and logic concerned with meaning.

categories.name: Pragmatics
categories.definition: The branch of linguistics dealing with language in use and the contexts in which it is used.

categories.name: Phonetics
categories.definition: The study and classification of speech sounds.

categories.name: Phonology
categories.definition: The branch of linguistics that deals with systems of sounds, especially in a particular language.

categories.name: Lexicography
categories.definition: The activity or profession of writing dictionaries.

categories.name: Terminology
categories.definition: The body of terms used with a particular technical application in a subject of study, profession, etc.

categories.name: Jargon
categories.definition: Special words or expressions used by a profession or group that are difficult for others to understand.

categories.name: Slang
categories.definition: A type of language consisting of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

categories.name: Idiom
categories.definition: A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words.

categories.name: Proverb
categories.definition: A short pithy saying in general use, stating a general truth or piece of advice.

categories.name: Quote
categories.definition: A quotation from a text or speech.

categories.name: Citation
categories.definition: A quotation from or reference to a book, paper, or author, especially in a scholarly work.

categories.name: Reference
categories.definition: The use of a source of information in order to ascertain something.

categories.name: Source
categories.definition: A place, person, or thing from which something originates or can be obtained.

categories.name: Archive
categories.definition: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

categories.name: Library
categories.definition: A collection of books and other materials for reading or reference.

categories.name: Museum
categories.definition: A building or place where objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are stored and exhibited.

categories.name: Gallery
categories.definition: A room or building for the display or sale of works of art.

categories.name: Exhibition
categories.definition: A public display of works of art or other items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.

categories.name: Collection
categories.definition: A group of things or people.

categories.name: Item
categories.definition: An individual article or unit, especially one that is part of a list, collection, or set.

categories.name: Object
categories.definition: A material thing that can be seen and touched.

categories.name: Artifact
categories.definition: An object made by a human being, typically one of cultural or historical interest.

categories.name: Relic
categories.definition: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.

categories.name: Antique
categories.definition: A collectible object such as a piece of furniture or work of art that has a high value because of its considerable age.

categories.name: Collectible
categories.definition: An item valued and sought by collectors.

categories.name: Souvenir
categories.definition: A thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event.

categories.name: Gift
categories.definition: A thing given willingly to someone without payment; a present.

categories.name: Donation
categories.definition: Something that is given to a charity, especially a sum of money.

categories.name: Bequest
categories.definition: The action of bequeathing something.

categories.name: Inheritance
categories.definition: A thing that is inherited.

categories.name: Heirloom
categories.definition: A valuable object that has belonged to a family for several generations.

categories.name: Treasure
categories.definition: A quantity of precious metals, gems, or other valuable objects.

categories.name: Hoard
categories.definition: A stock or store of money or valued objects, typically one that is secret or carefully guarded.
